relationships.subject: MAP2K1 mutation
relationships.evidence_quote: Affected iMSCs cultured for 48h in normal media showed a six-fold increased VEGF release in the supernatant compared to the mutation-free iMSCs

relationships.subject: trametinib
relationships.evidence_quote: when affected iMSCs were given the MEK1 inhibitor trametinib, the secretion of VEGF decreased from a mean of 601.2 ± 29.7 pg/mL to 417.2 ±31.2 pg/mL

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: After 21 days of osteogenic differentiation, we found significantly increased Alizarin red staining in unaffected iMSCs supplemented with 20 ng/mL VEGF

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Quantification by spectrophotometry confirmed that treatment with bevacizumab significantly decreased the total mineralization of affected cells, whereas mineralization of the unaffected cells remained unchanged

key_findings: MAP2K1-mutant iMSCs and osteoblasts secrete elevated VEGF, reduced by trametinib.
VEGF neutralization with bevacizumab reduced excess mineralization in affected cells.
